name: netw5
description: The MACRAW driver on the host's real network (NOT in the gate: a real DHCP server and LAN traffic). The release /etc/rc is staged back, so the network modules load at boot and /etc/netstart's dhclient takes a lease through the kernel stack; the probe's wire cases wait for the gateway that lease puts in the chip. Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 1.  ntpd starts at boot and asks for each interface's flags by the name SIOCGIFCONF gave it: 2.11BSD's ifunit takes the first digit as the unit, so an interface name must be letters.

screen_contains: bsdnet: five full frames sent in ticks

requires.reason: the probe C is compiled into the network modules only at kernel.netprobe = 1
